headline: Proposed Station 5 update and FY28 budget discussion update, plus a lieutenant promotion for Ryan Morse.
summary: Staff reports, a Local 789 discussion, and 14 sealed non-public minutes are also on the agenda. Items include the 2026 meeting dates and the by-laws.
